descriptionChirho: Piel transitive sense of bestowing glory or honor upon someone, treating them as distinguished or exalted.
Piel transitive sense of making something physically beautiful, decorating or embellishing it.
Hitpael reflexive sense of showing or gaining glory, used especially of God manifesting His own glory.
Hitpael reflexive sense of boasting, glorying in something, or vaunting oneself with pride.
